desc:
Car Dashcam Crash Simulator is a sandbox game about smashing cars with dashcam. Drive fast and crash into things. You can test the physics, and wreck your vehicle. You can also run over other players roaming the map, but the main point of the game is just to cause big car crashes. 

Car Crashing Dashcam
Dashcam view 
Realistic car crash physics and destruction
Choose to crash or be run over!
Endless chaos and excitement
Crash cars 
Break cars
